answer: For an inherited car, bring your uncle's death certificate plus either court letters naming you executor or administrator of the estate, or, for a small estate that doesn't go through probate court, the heir and estate affidavit (form NW-EST-1) signed by the heir. If there are several heirs, the executor signs or every heir signs NW-EST-1. Because there's still a loan, the lender holds the title, so the missing paper title isn't something the lost-title process covers. The help center article on selling a car you're still paying off isn't available here, so please contact a store for what you need for the loan.
